summary: Stage 3 closeout, frontend only, driven by D-pad key simulation. Automated pass rate: 126 of 129 checks passed (97.7%). Manual observations are not counted. Two checks were excluded: (a) one A check where my script went through osk-key-e, so the app correctly remembered E as the last key; (b) one 4K-height check, because the browser tool caps the viewport at 3840x1920. Results by area: A Search entry 17/19, B isolated empty library 15/15, C isolated removed title 19/20, D-Discover 23/23, D-Search 15/15, D-Atlas 19/19, D-Home/detail/player/settings/reduced motion 15/15, E 4K at 3840x1920 3/3. PASS: Enter, click and '/' on nav-search all land on osk-key-a on first entry and on the last-used key (osk-key-k) afterwards. Typing 'nor' gives exactly 'nor', focus stays on the OSK key and the OSK stays visible. Up from osk-key-a goes to search-input, then to the top nav. Back from a result restores both the query and the exact result. Empty library: Home first-run, discover-empty-library with discover-add-folder and no filter bar, atlas-empty with atlas-add-folder, and the search no-results state are all keyboard reachable, and focus never lands on body. Removed title: Discover index 10 -> Back gives one fewer title and focus on the new index 10 (the former 11). Removing the last item clamps focus to the new last index. Search: focus goes to the result now at the same index; if the only result is removed, focus goes to an OSK key and the no-results state shows. Atlas: Documentary 3->2 keeps the cluster and focuses a remaining node; a vanished Adventure cluster zooms out one level. Full regression all green, including the filter sheet that now opens on its first option, and deep restore of index 129 at exact scrollY 6252. FAIL: (1) Up from OSK top-row keys E and F skips search-input and goes to nav-discover / nav-atlas. (2) After a cluster inside 'More genres' vanishes, the parent level still shows the removed genre with its old count, because the group's children come from the sessionStorage snapshot.

ui_bugs.issue: ArrowUp from osk-key-e and osk-key-f (top row, right side) goes to nav-discover / nav-atlas instead of search-input. A-D work. RCA: pickNext scores Up by the centre-x distance. The input is wide (x 157-662) and its centre is about 150px from E, so the nav link straight above (primary about 135 + secondary about 37) beats the input (primary about 28 + 1.2*150). Fix: add data-nav-up='[data-testid="search-input"]' to the first .osk-row in Osk.tsx, or in spatial.ts use the horizontal overlap (0 when the elements overlap) as the secondary distance instead of the centre distance.

ui_bugs.component: Atlas 'More genres'/'More collections' level after data change
ui_bugs.issue: Steps: Atlas > More genres > Adventure (1 title) > open the title > delete it on disk and rescan > Back. Atlas correctly zooms out to More genres, but that level still lists Adventure ('1 title', 9 groups) and focus lands on that stale node. The overview itself is fresh (48 titles). RCA: Atlas.tsx stores the whole AtlasNode, including children, in the horizon.atlas.stack session entry, and groupItems = node.children. The 'more' children are never refreshed from the new /api/atlas response. Fix: on load, rebuild each stack level's node from the fresh data by id (look up the 'more' node by id in overview), or store only ids in the stack.

ui_bugs.component: Atlas overview focus after counts change
ui_bugs.issue: Back from the Documentary cluster after its count dropped from 3 to 2: focus lands on Science Fiction, not Documentary. The rings are sorted by count and focus is remembered as a [ring, index] position, not a node id. Minor: focus is valid, but on a different node. Fix: also store the focused node key and prefer it when restoring.

There is no D-pad path to search-clear-button. Right from the OSK stops at the edge (exitRight only looks for [data-key]), and Right from the input goes to nav-search. The OSK Clear key is an alternative. Fix: have exitRight fall back to the first button in .search-results.

issues: The enlarged focused Science Fiction node covers the 'More collections' label in the outer ring (it reads 'Mo…ollections').

action_items: Osk.tsx: make Up from every top-row key go to search-input (add data-nav-up on the first osk-row, or fix the Up secondary distance in spatial.ts)
Atlas.tsx: rebuild the stored stack nodes (especially kind 'more' with children) from the fresh /api/atlas data, so removed groups disappear
Optional: restore Atlas overview focus by node id; make search-clear-button reachable by D-pad; avoid the focused-node scale covering neighbouring labels
critical_code_review_comments: Atlas.tsx line 90: the stack keeps whole AtlasNode objects (with children) in sessionStorage. This causes stale data after rescans and makes the session entry large on big libraries.

Search.tsx line 77: if a restored result is gone and there are no results, focus goes to the first .osk-key (A), not the last-used key stored in horizon.search.oskKey. This is acceptable but inconsistent.
spatial.ts pickNext: for Up/Down, the centre-to-centre secondary distance penalises wide targets such as inputs. An overlap-based distance would fix this class of bug app-wide.
